notes: The main path of the tool and the case the pre-existing Python test covers, except that the test only compared the BAM by byte size within 80,000. 99,983 read pairs against 599,308 DpnII cut sites, 33,754 bins of 5 kb, 37,321 valid contacts, 35,857 stored pixels. The BAM comes out byte identical, which also fixes the reference for --outBam: it is the record order the Python produces with a single worker. Budget 2*35857*12 + 4*64 MB + 64 MB per cpp/STATUS.md.

No --binSize, so the bins come from get_rf_bins: one bin per DpnII site, sites closer than 150 bp merged, 1500 bp added on each side, 266,464 bins over 15 chromosomes. This is the path where the bin table is larger than the matrix is dense, and where the c_uint truncation of the shared interval array matters.

Two restriction enzymes, two cut site files and two dangling sequences, matched by position. This is the case in which the self circle loop of buildMatrixMethods.py:744-762 can count one pair twice, because has_rf is accumulated across the sequences but the counter is incremented once per sequence that has not found a site yet.

--region restricts the bins to chr3R, 5,582 of them, and 7,623 pixels survive. It also empties the restriction site list, because bed2interval_list keeps a site only when region_end <= site_end and region_end is the chromosome length (the QUIRK note in build_matrix.hpp). Every close inward pair therefore becomes 'same fragment' and no self circle is ever counted. Reproduced rather than fixed.

The cool writer with metadata. The three provenance strings are built with np.string_ and stored by hicmatrix as str(bytes), so the attribute really reads b'HiCExplorer-3.7.6' and the port writes that literally; see Q9 in hicBuildMatrix.cpp. 'statistics', the whole QC log, is put into the metadata dictionary and then dropped by hicmatrix, which never copies it into the info dictionary it writes.

Three resolutions, so the mcool branch is taken and the two coarser ones come from hicMergeMatrixBins.merge_bins on the 5 kb matrix: 35,857, 34,331 and 31,230 pixels. Only /resolutions/5000 carries the provenance attributes, because hicmatrix's cool writer deletes them out of the metadata dictionary it is handed and the tool reuses the same dictionary for every resolution (Q10).

The bin table comes from the chrom.sizes file rather than from the BAM header, which changes both the chromosome order and the lengths, so the bin ids and the matrix shape differ from the default path.

--minMappingQuality was never exercised by the Python suite with an assertion. At 30 rather than the default 15 the mappable pair count falls from 300 to 229 and the contacts from 215 to 180. This is also the case that pins the chained comparison of buildMatrixMethods.py:523, which charges a pair to 'One mate not unique' on the first mate's quality alone.

--maxDistance, the obsolete spelling, was never exercised by the Python suite. It overwrites --maxLibraryInsertSize outright, so this run is identical to --maxLibraryInsertSize 1500 down to the QC log.

--keepSelfLigation was never exercised by the Python suite. It keeps the 5 self ligated pairs, so the contacts rise from 215 to 220 and the QC label changes from 'self ligation (removed)' to 'self ligation (not removed)'. Unlike --keepSelfCircles it really does change the matrix.

--keepSelfCircles is a no-op on the matrix and on every QC counter, because the `continue` that was meant to drop a self circle sits inside the loop over restriction sequences rather than inside the read loop (Q2). The output is identical to the run without the flag, which is the point of the case: it pins a defect, not a feature.

--skipDuplicationCheck was never exercised with an assertion. R1_1000 holds no duplicate pair, so the counters are unchanged and what the case really pins is that skipping the check does not perturb anything else. The 12 duplicates of the larger library are covered by the QC cases below.

The QC folder is a downstream contract: hicPrepareQCreport reads QC.log and every one of these tables is what a user looks at. QC.log and the tables embed the --outFileName string, so this case gives it as a name relative to the shared work directory instead of a path under {out}; the matrix that lands there is deliberately not compared, the sibling case above does that. Byte identical, E0, including the float reprs pandas writes with no format string.
The QC log of the restriction fragment path, which reports 'Min rest. site distance 150' and a different self ligation and same fragment split from the fixed bin run.

--doTestRun and --doTestRunLines were never exercised with an assertion. The whole QC log is produced but no matrix file is written at all, and the pixel arrays are never filled, which is the only thing the quick QC mode saves. With 983 pairs in the file the 500 line limit is reached on the first buffer and the counters cover the whole file anyway.

Two enzymes and --keepSelfCircles together, which is the combination that exposes the double counting of Q2: a self circle that neither enzyme finds a site for is added to the counter once per enzyme. discarded_table.txt is included because its column set is built by substring matching on 'dangling end', so the two per enzyme dangling end columns appear there as percentages only.

buildMatrixMethods.py:880-883 rejects a file name whose extension is neither h5 nor cool nor mcool, before anything is read. The port reproduces the status and the message; the Python test suite marks the same situation xfail and asserts nothing about it.

PLAN 9.2, class EX: E2 against the BAM route. The .pairs file holds exactly the 37,321 read pairs the Python hicBuildMatrix keeps from small_test_R1/R2_unsorted.bam at 5 kb with DpnII, written by cpp/scripts/make_bam_route_pairs.py --mode valid (sorted, upper triangle, bgzip, pair_type and mapq columns) at each read's middle plus one; 9 read ends sit one base to the left, because the Python's closed interval search put a middle that equals a shared bin end into the left bin. The reference, py_pairs_bam_route_reference.py, runs that BAM route from the arguments recorded in the file's header. --skipDuplicationCheck because the BAM route already removed duplicates by read start: two of the kept pairs share both read middles, and the pairs route's own check would remove them (pixels (2725, 2728) and (4347, 4379), measured); the reference does not pass the flag on. Pixels, bins, chromosomes and attributes are compared.

The h5 writer of the .pairs route against the BAM route, on the file and with the reasoning of the cool case above. /intervals/extra_list is excluded: it holds the BAM route's per bin maximum of read coverage, which needs read lengths a .pairs file does not carry, and the pairs route writes NaN there (build_matrix_pairs_impl.hpp O2). The node must still exist; the matrix and the other interval lists compare E2.

The mcool branch of the .pairs route against the BAM route: three resolutions, the coarser two merged from 5 kb, with the provenance only on the first (Q7, Q10), on the file and with the reasoning of the cool case above.

Restriction fragment bins from a .pairs file against the BAM route: 266,464 bins from DpnII.bed with --minDistance 150 and --maxLibraryInsertSize 1500. The file holds the 36,627 pairs the BAM route keeps with those bins, in BAM order (#sorted: none), with only the seven reserved columns and no #columns line, so no mapping quality filter applies. 80 read ends sit one base to the left of their middle, where the closed search put a middle on the shared end of two touching fragment bins into the left one. --skipDuplicationCheck for the reason given in the fixed bin case.

PLAN 9.2, class EX: E2 against cooler cload pairs (cooler 0.10.2) on the same file and the same 5 kb bins from its #chromsize lines. The pairs route's duplicate check runs in file order on this sorted, upper triangle file; the reference applies the pair_type, mapping quality and duplicate filters with its own code before cooler bins the pairs (py_pairs_cooler_reference.py). Four attributes are excluded because the two writers differ in them by design: matrix-generated-by and matrix-generated-by-url (hicBuildMatrix provenance, Q9), format-url (cooler's current and hicmatrix's old repository address) and metadata (cooler writes an empty object, hicmatrix its provenance dictionary). Pixels, bins, chromosome names and lengths, and every other attribute, including nnz and sum, are compared. cpp_args: --noPlot, the C++-only option that writes the QC tables without the QC figures. cooler draws nothing, so without it the memory gate would weigh the matplotlib process of the QC report (about 210 MB) against a reference that has none; the same holds for every case against cooler.

The filters of the .pairs route (P1 to P4) against cooler on pairs filtered independently. small_test_all.pairs.gz holds all 99,983 primary read pairs of small_test_R1/R2_unsorted.bam in pairtools' conventions (make_bam_route_pairs.py --mode all): 3,026 NN, 5,571 NU, 85 NM, 95 MN, 7,221 MU, 23 MM and 83,962 UU pairs, mapq columns, chr1 and chr2 column names as ENCODE writes them, sorted and upper triangle, with duplicated pairs. The route drops the unmapped, not unique, below mapq 15 and duplicated pairs; the reference drops the same with its own code and gives the rest to cooler. Attributes excluded as in the case above.
The case above at 20 kb with --skipDuplicationCheck: the duplicated pairs are counted in both matrices, the other filters still apply on both sides.

A plain, unsorted .pairs file (all 983 primary read pairs of R1_1000/R2_1000.bam, BAM order, #sorted: none), so the duplicate check runs on the hash set, and a mapping quality threshold of 30. 229 pairs remain, the mappable count of the BAM route at the same threshold (hicBuildMatrix.h5.R1_1000.minMappingQuality30). Attributes excluded as in hicBuildMatrix.pairs.cool.binSize5000.vs_cooler.

cooler with nothing in between: the file has only the seven reserved columns and no #columns line, so it has no pair_type and no mapq columns, and with --skipDuplicationCheck the reference hands the file itself to cooler cload pairs. Unsorted bgzip input at 10 kb. Attributes excluded as in hicBuildMatrix.pairs.cool.binSize5000.vs_cooler.
